title: Hearty Light Portuguese Tofu Stew
description: A grassy and light Portuguese stew featuring dark soy sauce and braised tofu, perfect for a solo dinner, this dish is also Jain-friendly.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dark soy sauce, tomato paste, and vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini and cubed potatoes, and continue to simmer for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
